{{Quote|A bit ''too'' seriously, my friend. I've been killed once. It didn't take.|Attuma Duum to Sabat|<ref name="shonju" />}}
'''Attuma Duum''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], weapons dealer, and war profiteer who died but was rebuilt into a cyborg body prior to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he played the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] against each other, luring two [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] to his [[Attuma Duum's headquarters|asteroid field base.]] He encountered [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Shon-Ju]] during the battle in but escaped with his life.

==Biography==
{{Expandsect}}
Prior to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Attuma Duum met [[Death/Legends|death]] but was resurrected in a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] body, with only his face left. He disguised his true form. Over the years, various parties had sent many [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] after him, including [[flesh-eating nanobots]], [[brain-sniper]]s from [[Latza VII]], and a [[Xandonian night terror]].<ref name="shonju" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he had a [[Attuma Duum's headquarters|base]] in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid field]] near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Cavamina Minor]]. To profit from the war, he passed on information to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. He lured both a Republic and Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to his base under false pretenses, ambushing the two fleets with a [[Space mine/Legends|minefield]].<ref name="shonju" />

Prior to the battle, Duum had captured two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] with the help of his friend and chief of security, [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]]. The two captives escaped and confronted Duum after killing Sabat. Duum engaged in one-on-one combat with [[Shon-Ju]], but was bested. [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] intervened to save Shon-Ju from finishing the destruction of Duum's damaged body. Duum entered a [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|Class-6 escape pod]] and rocketed away from his doomed base. Even though his empire was crippled, Duum planned on rebuilding.<ref name="shonju" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|''Personal enjoyment'' isn't reason enough? What you Jedi don't understand is that your wars are ''pointless.'' And the longer they drag out&mdash;the longer ''I'' can drag them out&mdash;the ''richer'' I get. So why not have some fun, too?|Duum to Aayla Secura|<ref name="shonju" />}}
After his death, he portrayed a cavalier attitude to death. He disguised his appearance to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy at large]] with a blond wig and good clothes, including an expensive cape. Duum was devoted to credits, and was willing to play both sides of the war against each other, and called the deception fun. He overestimated his fighting ability against Shon-Ju and fled after Secura intervened to keep Shon-Ju from killing him.<ref name="shonju" />

==Behind the scenes==
Attuma Duum appears in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''. His name is misspelled "Atuma Duum" on the summary on the back of the novella.
